objective: Produce the visual direction and PDF-expression contribution for the shared book-PDF workflow.
requestedOutcome: At least ten original raster editorial directions plus reference synthesis, PDF expression mapping, a dynamic artifact specification, validation, and a digest-bound handoff.
successEvidence: At least ten distinct PNG or JPEG visual mockup files exist and pass file/size inspection.
Every visual direction maps to concrete PDF roles and layout tokens.
Reference claims are source-linked and distinguished from local design inference.
The dynamic artifact specification defines roles, handoffs, mutable state, validation, change signals, and stop conditions.
The handoff binds the common collaboration-bundle revision and digest.
nonGoals: Publishing or distributing a final production PDF.
Copying a named book's protected trade dress or internal page design.
Changing application source, package boundaries, or external provider state.
boundedDiscoverySurface: Existing repository document/PDF production artifacts and collaboration contracts.
Primary publisher or author sources for relevant technical-book structures.
Task-local image generation and PDF-expression specifications.
validation: Image inventory, MIME type, dimensions, and visual review.
materialChangeSignals: Objective, recipient, native owner, artifact revision, consumer, effect, route/topology, lifecycle, or protected constraint changes.
stopConditions: Required ownership, provenance, image-generation capability, or output validation cannot be established.
The same visual-generation or validation fingerprint fails twice without new evidence.
The bounded task-local candidate would require editing AGENTS.md or another writer's owned files.
